## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] A test covers the change (behaviour changes usually belong in `internal/e2e`)
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (the list is at the bottom of `AGENTS.md`), and `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No new third-party dependency, or the reason is explained above
- [ ] Nothing here logs a secret, loosens the panel's guards, or lets a peer reach more than it is shared
